title: System console
description: Check database, storage, mail, and runtime configuration, then restart the service when it is managed by PM2.
loadFailed: Failed to load the system console.
checkDescription: Diagnostics stream from the current server process as they run.
checkOpen: Connection open. Diagnostics appear as they finish.
checkUnsupported: Live diagnostics are unavailable because no WebSocket server address is configured for this deployment. Ask an administrator to set the WebSocket base URL.
checkEmpty: No diagnostics have been reported yet.
restartDescription: Reload the running process through PM2. The page becomes temporarily unavailable while the service restarts.
restartDone: Restart requested. The service is reloading.
restartUnavailable: Restart is unavailable when the service is not launched by PM2.
settingsDescription: Edit the values stored in the system configuration. Secret fields stay unchanged when left blank.
settingEmpty: No settings are available for this server.
settingSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
settingDisabled: This setting is managed by the server and cannot be edited.
settingUnsupported: This setting cannot be changed from this page because of its key format. Edit it in Raw configuration.
configDescription: Edit the YAML configuration directly. Schema hints help you avoid invalid values.
configSecretsHint: Secret values show as [hidden]. Leave them as-is to keep the stored value.
scriptDescription: Run a registered administrative script with JSON arguments. Results appear as a submission record.
scriptEmpty: No scripts are registered on this server.
scriptDialogDescription: Provide arguments for the script, then run it to open its result record.
userPrivDescription: Inspect and change the global privilege bits for an account or the server default.
userPrivEmpty: No accounts match the current filter.
userPrivDefaultHint: Applied to every account that still uses the default privilege set.
userPrivSearchHint: Search by username, email, or user ID to edit an account that is not listed.
userPrivDialogDescription: Select the global privilege bits this account should have.
userPrivAllHint: This account is a super administrator and cannot be changed here.
statusDescription: Live status for judge nodes, compiler versions, and language execution commands.
statusEmpty: No judge nodes have reported recently.
statusNoCompilers: No compiler versions have been reported.
